disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to comply with the rules and requirements of the division of professional regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Certificates issued under this chapter may...be suspended or revoked by the director of labor and training, upon failure or refusal of the licensee to comply with the rules and requirements of the division of professional regulation or for other sufficient cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to do electrical work in accordance with city or town rules and requirements, or failure to correct defective work after notice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to do electrical work in accordance with the National Electrical Code or division requirements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misstatements as to experience or qualifications in license application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person applying for a license and making any misstatement as to his or her experience or other qualifications...shall be subject to the penalties prescribed in § 5-6-32.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in electrical work without having complied with the licensing provisions of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person, firm, association, corporation, or employee of any person, firm, association, or corporation...entering upon or engaging in the previously defined business and work, without having complied with the provisions of this chapter, shall be assessed penalties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal to permit or obstruction of entry by division investigators for inspection of electrical work
